source_caption_text:
Yeat tried communicating with his own Fortnite NPC through whistles during his stream with Clix 😭😂

 “We communicating…”

Via: X/Gotclippd
Coming face-to-face with your own character wasn’t enough—Yeat had to see if they spoke the same language 💀 The rapper stopped in front of his in-game counterpart and started whistling at him while Clix watched the interaction unfold.

The moment comes as Yeat officially brings his world into Fortnite through his latest collaboration. His collection includes both the Yeat and Twizz outfits, along with accessories like the Bell Flail pickaxe, Lyfestyle Eye back bling and Nike x Yeat Air Max Goadome kicks. The crossover also features the “Aura Transfer” and “Luh Dumptruck” emotes, plus an “If We Being Rëal” Jam Track 🎮🔔

Between having his music in the game, his own outfits and an NPC he can walk up to, Yeat now gets to experience Fortnite as both the player and the character 😂🔥

Did you pick up anything from his collab? 👀
